1.0.0
=============
* Solution architecture:
    * [#142002](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/142002) -- Product Multi-View. Solution architecture
* New features:
    * [#141997](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/141997) -- SETTING. As an admin, I want to be able to enable/disable multi-view for the product listing page (see description)
    * [#142004](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/142004) -- PRODUCT MANAGEMENT. As an admin, I want to be able to manage "Alternative image" for the product (see description)
    * [#142003](https://ewave.tpondemand.com/entity/142003) -- PRODUCT LISTING. As a user, I want to see multiple images for the product on the product listing page (see description)
